_note: Prologue, the storm night over Brindlewick (plan item 1410). Starts over black. Three text boxes (Chimora 100 item 26): the lore that was cut here (the cartographers, the Hush, Mirela's lost Rift) is told by Aldo and on Mirela's first map page.

say: Last night a storm tore the sky. Rifts opened over Veydal.
Three small lights crossed the lake to the lighthouse lamp.
